The issuer appears to have a solid investment-grade profile: profitability is strong (EBIT margin near 30%), retained earnings are exceptionally large relative to assets, and equity supports a meaningful portion of the balance sheet. Offsetting that, liquidity is only modest (current ratio 1.07) and liabilities are still material relative to assets, so the profile looks stronger than BBB but not quite in the high-A/AA range.

DECISION: A-
